headline.zh-CN: 曲师账号选择与 UID 复制
headline.en: Composer account selection and UID copying

summary.zh-CN: 专辑管理者可在上传页搜索曲师账号，社团和专辑成员页支持查看、复制 UID。
summary.en: Album managers can search composer accounts during upload and copy UIDs from circle and album members.

description.zh-CN: 按显示名、用户名或 UID 搜索当前专辑可绑定的账号。选中后填入 UID，并预填空艺名；已有艺名、手工 UID 和外部曲师行继续保留。
description.en: Search eligible accounts by display name, username or UID. Selection fills the UID and an empty alias while preserving existing aliases, manual UIDs and external composers.

description.zh-CN: 社团成员和专辑团队展示 UID，点击复制纯数字；复制失败时可选中文本手动复制。
description.en: Circle members and album teams show UIDs. Click to copy the numeric ID, or select the text manually if copying fails.
